assignments.mission: Decide A/B/C using only the test data: parse incrementality vs cannibalization (expo overlap, social concentration), assess unit economics (free-month cost, ARPU/retention tradeoff, delayed cash), identify overinterpreted metrics, isolate reliable long-term signals, define what new results would change the call, and judge if evidence justifies a 3‑year reallocation.

reason: This is a company-level, long-term resource decision centered on causality and unit economics from a biased test. A single business strategist can synthesize the evidence and make the call without external market inputs or creative design at this stage.
